global_parameters.theta: <float> Fraction of each customer's total demand that requires type I service.
global_parameters.sigma: <float> Fraction of type I demand served at any facility that generates a subsequent referral need for type II service.
global_parameters.alpha: <float> Per-unit-demand per-unit-distance cost for shipping type I demand from a customer to a level I facility.
global_parameters.beta: <float> Per-unit-demand per-unit-distance cost for shipping type I or type II demand from a customer to a level II facility.
global_parameters.gamma: <float> Per-unit-demand per-unit-distance cost for forwarding referral demand from any facility to a level II facility.
global_parameters.alpha_prime: <float> Per-unit cost of outsourcing type I demand.
global_parameters.beta_prime: <float> Per-unit cost of outsourcing type II demand.
global_parameters.gamma_prime: <float> Per-unit cost of outsourcing referral demand.
global_parameters.R: <float> Radius of the circular region in which customers are located.
global_parameters.L: <float> Side length of the square region in which facilities are placed.
global_parameters.rho1: <float> Cost of fully interdicting one level I facility.
global_parameters.rho2: <float> Cost of fully interdicting one level II facility.

instance_parameters.num_level1_facilities: <int> Number of level I facilities that provide only type I service.
instance_parameters.num_level2_facilities: <int> Number of level II facilities that provide both type I and type II service.
instance_parameters.num_customers: <int> Number of customers with demand to be served.
instance_parameters.num_interdiction_levels_K: <int> Total number of interdiction intensity levels available, including level zero (no attack).
instance_parameters.k_max: <int> Maximum interdiction intensity level that can be assigned to a facility.
instance_parameters.budget_level: <str> Qualitative label indicating the interdiction budget tier.
instance_parameters.total_interdiction_budget: <float> Maximum total expenditure the interdictor may spend across all facility attacks.

interdiction_parameters.interdiction_cost_level1_h1: <dict, key: '{intensity_level}'> Cost incurred by the interdictor for attacking a level I facility at each positive intensity level.
interdiction_parameters.interdiction_cost_level2_h2: <dict, key: '{intensity_level}'> Cost incurred by the interdictor for attacking a level II facility at each positive intensity level.
interdiction_parameters.capacity_reduction_level1_d1: <dict, key: '{intensity_level}'> Fraction of original type I capacity lost at a level I facility for each positive intensity level.
interdiction_parameters.capacity_reduction_level2_d2: <dict, key: '{intensity_level}'> Fraction of original capacity lost at a level II facility for each positive intensity level, applied to both type I and type II capacity.

customers.x_coordinates: <list[float], length num_customers> Horizontal coordinate of each customer in the two-dimensional plane.
customers.y_coordinates: <list[float], length num_customers> Vertical coordinate of each customer in the two-dimensional plane.
customers.demands: <list[float], length num_customers> Total service demand of each customer, split between type I and type II according to theta.

level1_facilities.x_coordinates: <list[float], length num_level1_facilities> Horizontal coordinate of each level I facility.
level1_facilities.y_coordinates: <list[float], length num_level1_facilities> Vertical coordinate of each level I facility.
level1_facilities.capacity_type1: <list[float], length num_level1_facilities> Maximum amount of type I demand each level I facility can serve before interdiction.

level2_facilities.x_coordinates: <list[float], length num_level2_facilities> Horizontal coordinate of each level II facility.
level2_facilities.y_coordinates: <list[float], length num_level2_facilities> Vertical coordinate of each level II facility.
level2_facilities.capacity_type1: <list[float], length num_level2_facilities> Maximum amount of type I demand each level II facility can serve before interdiction.
level2_facilities.capacity_type2: <list[float], length num_level2_facilities> Maximum combined type II and referral demand each level II facility can serve before interdiction.

distances.customer_to_level1_facility: <list[list[float]], shape [num_customers][num_level1_facilities]> Euclidean distance from each customer to each level I facility.
distances.customer_to_level2_facility: <list[list[float]], shape [num_customers][num_level2_facilities]> Euclidean distance from each customer to each level II facility.
distances.level1_to_level2_facility: <list[list[float]], shape [num_level1_facilities][num_level2_facilities]> Euclidean distance from each level I facility to each level II facility, used for referral forwarding costs.
